title: Add OAuth login to the web app
summaryHtml: Replace the homegrown password flow with OAuth (Google + GitHub), feature-flagged with a staged rollout.

sections.heading: 1. Database changes
sections.bodyHtml:
Add an identities table linking users to providers:

CREATE TABLE identities (
  id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id BIGINT REFERENCES users(id),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (provider, provider_uid)
);

The existing sessions table stays as-is; we only add a nullable identity_id column.

sections.heading: 2. Auth endpoints
sections.bodyHtml:
New routes in src/auth/oauth.ts:

  • GET /auth/:provider — redirect to provider consent screen
  • GET /auth/:provider/callback — exchange code, upsert identity, mint session
  • POST /auth/logout — unchanged

State parameter is a signed nonce stored in a short-lived cookie to block CSRF.

sections.heading: 3. Login UI
sections.bodyHtml: Replace the password form with provider buttons; keep the password form behind a “use legacy login” toggle for one release while accounts migrate.

sections.heading: 4. Rollout & testing
sections.bodyHtml: Feature-flagged (oauth_login). Integration tests hit a mock provider; canary to 5% of traffic for 48h before full rollout.
